name: Sync to video (ffsubsync)
description: Re-times this subtitle so it matches the attached video's speech.

params.label: Large offset search
params.help: Turn on when the subtitles are far off or you don't know how far out they are. It searches harder to find the right shift, so it takes a little longer.

name: Sync to another subtitle (ffsubsync)
description: Re-times this subtitle to match a correctly-timed reference subtitle open in another window.

params.label: Reference subtitle
params.help: The correctly-timed subtitle window to sync against

params.label: Large offset search
params.help: Turn on when the subtitles are far off or you don't know how far out they are. It searches harder to find the right shift, so it takes a little longer.

name: Sync to video (alass)
description: Re-times this subtitle against the attached video, correcting offset, framerate drift and scene splits.

name: Sync to another subtitle (alass)
description: Re-times this subtitle to match a correctly-timed reference subtitle open in another window.

params.label: Reference subtitle
params.help: The correctly-timed subtitle window to sync against

name: Extract subtitles from video (ffmpeg)
description: Extracts an embedded subtitle track from the attached video and loads it into this window. Converts to SubRip, dropping any styling.

params.label: Subtitle stream
params.help: Which embedded subtitle to pull out of the video. Only text subtitles are listed — picture-based ones can't be turned into editable text.

name: Generate subtitles from audio (faster-whisper)
description: Writes subtitles from the words spoken in the audio. The easy, all-round choice: quick to set up and runs on any computer.

params.label: Model
params.help: Bigger settings give more accurate subtitles but take longer. "small" is a good balance; "tiny" and "base" are fast and rough; "medium" and "large" are slow but best.

params.label: Better on songs and music
params.help: Keep on for films and anything with music: it keeps the timing accurate, stops repeated or invented lines, and gives cleaner, better-split subtitles even on plain dialogue. Turn off only for special cases.

name: Generate subtitles from audio (whisper.cpp)
description: Writes subtitles from the words spoken in the audio, using your computer's graphics chip to go faster. Needs a model file you download once, and the audio preview to be generated first.

params.label: Model file
params.help: Choose the model file you downloaded. Bigger models give more accurate subtitles but take longer.

params.label: Better on songs and music
params.help: Keep on for films and anything with music: it stops the subtitles filling up with sound tags like [music] or the same line repeated over and over (without it, long stretches can be lost). Turn off only for plain, music-free speech.

name: Re-time subtitles to the audio (stable-ts)
description: Takes the words from your current subtitles and re-times them to match what is spoken in the audio - for when the text is right but the timing is off. Generate the audio preview first.

params.label: Language
params.help: The language spoken in the audio.

params.label: Model
params.help: Bigger settings align more accurately but take longer; "small" is a good balance.

name: Extract subtitles from video (mkvextract)
description: Extracts an embedded subtitle track from the attached Matroska (.mkv) video, keeping its original format and styling (e.g. ASS). For non-Matroska files use the ffmpeg recipe.

params.label: Subtitle stream
params.help: Which embedded subtitle to pull out of the video. Only text subtitles are listed, and each one keeps its original format and styling.
